⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Absolutely Amazing Experience!

This gaming café is hands-down one of the best I’ve ever been to. The setup is top-notch – high-end PCs with blazing-fast performance, ultra-smooth monitors, comfy chairs, and a perfect ambience for both casual and competitive gaming. Whether you’re grinding ranked matches or just chilling with friends, this place has it all.

The staff is super friendly and helpful, always making sure everything runs smoothly. The café is clean, well-organized, and has a great vibe overall. Plus, the snack and beverage options are a huge bonus – delicious and reasonably priced!

What stood out most was how well-maintained the equipment is and how seamless the gaming experience feels from the moment you log in. If you’re a gamer looking for a professional, cozy, and fun place to play – look no further.

Highly recommended for solo gamers, squads, and even tournaments. Will definitely be coming back regularly!

featured_reviews.name: Alric (Alric)
featured_reviews.review_text:
Dont know about the other reviews, but me personally as per my latest visit in January 2025, it was a very disappointing experience and I do not recommend at all if you want a comfortable time gaming.

Very crammed up space, the gaming chairs are broken, cheap peripherals setup. The gaming mouse is the g402 wired, cheap branded keyboard and headsets. Very dark and unhygenic atmosphere, just 1 Fan being pointed towards the reception desk where he works and 1 Air conditioning unit which is not being used to save costs unless the entire cafe is full I'm guessing.

The gaming experience on the PC is decent for now, 240hz monitors available and 3060ti GPU powered PCs.

The chairs are beyond terrible making it very uncomfortable to sit and since it's a very tiny room packed with setups there is barely any space to breathe.

If you're on an extremely tight budget and don't care about comfort, cleanliness and hygiene and just want to enjoy with your friends for the price of 60 rupees an hour, it is not bad for what you get. That's my honest review.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Celebrated my son’s Xth birthday at the newly opened Timezone (Skycity Mall Borivali)🎉🎳 Amazing experience!
The host Vidhi Vyas was bang on and managed a group of 24 super-energetic kids so smoothly. Bowling, dashing cars, and the overall games experience were a big hit with the kids.

featured_reviews.name: Guru Gym Foodie
featured_reviews.review_text: 10 pin Bowling in TimeZone. On Thursdays there is a waiting line of 200 people. Waiting time varies from 2 hours to 5 hours. After 4 pm the rate on Thursdays is just Rs.99. But it is amazing how Irshad and Shahid manage the crowd so well. The others too keep the crowd disciplined. I go regularly, so I must say I am impressed with both of them (er, the others I do not remember their names). They encourage me by lauding my bowling and scores. In fact I scored 168 today based on the demo given by Irshad. Amazing how Sky City Mall has become so popular and so crowded. I thank all the staff for their excellent service.

featured_reviews.name: Arshad Ali
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had an awesome time at Timezone Sky City! The bowling alley was fantastic—clean, fun, and really well-maintained. The atmosphere was energetic and perfect for a great day out.

A special shout-out to Irsad, who provided exceptional service. He was friendly, helpful, and made the experience even better with his professionalism and positive attitude. Staff like him truly make a difference!

Highly recommend this place for anyone looking for fun activities and great customer service.

If you want it shorter, more formal, or more enthusiastic, just let me know!🤩💯

featured_reviews.name: Om Sharma
featured_reviews.review_text:
Very worst experience with the staff and technician team. There was an issue with the game, and when I asked the staff for help, the first response I got was, “Inform the technician, not me.” Amazing customer service standards.

Even after I personally found the technician and explained the issue properly, he barely looked into it. We politely asked for either a refund or at least some game compensation since we had already spent so many points on that game and clearly know how to use it. But instead of helping, the technician arrogantly replied, “Who told you to play this game?” and “Don’t play this game.”

Seriously? Then why keep the game active if customers are not supposed to play it?

We even purchased a Gold Card worth ₹10,000 from the reception, expecting premium service, but instead got rude behavior and zero accountability. Rather than solving the issue, your staff questioned us for playing the game itself. Absolutely unbelievable.

I have visited many Timezone venues like Oberoi, Inorbit, R-City, Capital Mall, Growel’s, etc., and never experienced such pathetic customer service anywhere else. This branch has completely ruined the experience for me and my nephew.

The Venue Head, Prabhat, seriously needs to look into the behavior and attitude of the staff here. Customers are spending money to enjoy, not to get insulted for using the games available at the venue.

Truly disappointing. Negative rating from my side.

featured_reviews.review_text: Deepti and Vidhi from Timezone, Sky City Mall, Borivali were absolutely fantastic hosts. Both were energetic, engaging, and handled the party with great dedication. Their enthusiasm truly made the experience memorable.

featured_reviews.name: amin shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐ The Game Palacio – Bandra West

We visited The Game Palacio, located at Krystal Building, below Hakkasan, Bandra West, and it’s an amazing eat-drink-play destination. This place is famous for its bowling lanes, arcade & gaming activities, along with a stylish restaurant and bar.

We tried their refreshing mocktails – The Upside Down and The Sun Downer, both were really well balanced and refreshing. For food, we had Prawns & Avocado Salad, Scallion Flat Noodles, Mexican Chilli Garlic Prawns, and Tofu Chaat – everything was flavourful and well presented. We ended with the Berry Bliss dessert, which was a perfect sweet finish.

The ambience is lively, fun, and perfect for hanging out with friends or celebrating.
If you’re in Bandra, this place should definitely be on your list! 🎳🍹

featured_reviews.name: Estate Expert Ellie
featured_reviews.review_text:
Worst birthday experience ever.

Despite booking and paying in advance for a table and a bowling alley, we faced constant pushing and overcrowding (dhakka-mukki) throughout the evening. I raised the issue multiple times in advance with both the lady and male bouncers, yet every complaint was ignored.

Shockingly, one bouncer was openly encouraging other people to play for free on our paid bowling lane. PR staff casually brought their girlfriends to our table and bowling area, and one PR even took drinks from our table without permission.

To make matters worse, a man wearing a sleeveless vest (sando) — clearly allowed by this “sando-only club of Mumbai” — used extremely abusive and vulgar language, including offensive remarks involving mothers. What is most disturbing is that PRs, bouncers, and even one of the owners present at the time witnessed everything and chose to do nothing. They simply stood there and watched.

Let’s be honest — if such language had been used toward your sister or girlfriend, it would never have been tolerated. Stand for the truth.

The environment felt unsafe, unprofessional, and deeply disrespectful, especially for paying guests celebrating a private occasion. My birthday was completely ruined, and I will never recommend this place.

Public note:
Next time, boys and men — please wear sandos (ganjis) 😍
Apparently, this is the only club in Mumbai that proudly entertains men in innerwear 🤣🤣🤣🤣

Despite all this, there was not even a single apology. The PR (J*Y), who was never present to check on guest safety or comfort, suddenly appeared at billing time demanding cash.

PR J*Y and the owner present that night — after witnessing the abuse and repeated complaints, no one took a stand for the truth.

featured_reviews.name: Jay Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐ 1 Star

Extremely disappointing experience at Game Palacio Bandra. We booked a table for 8 people on a Saturday night by paying an advance amount through their PR, Jay, who assured us that we would get a bowling lane at 10:30 PM and specifically asked us to arrive accordingly. We reached at 10:35 PM—just 5 minutes late—and despite informing him and paying in advance, he told us that our lane had already been given away and that they could no longer assure us anything. This completely ruined our plans.

The worst part was that Jay made promises just to sell us the table and then failed to honor any of his commitments. We were willing to wait and stayed until closing time, but nobody followed up with us regarding bowling or provided any proper resolution.

There was also no prior communication that table service was restricted to bottle purchases only. After spending nearly ₹25,000, we were given a cramped table under the staircase where our heads were literally touching the stairs. Only after repeatedly requesting the manager and PR were we allowed to order beers and cocktails.

To make matters worse, a service charge of nearly ₹3,000 was added to the bill and was not removed despite multiple requests. We were incorrectly told it was mandatory, which is not in line with current government guidelines regarding service charges.

The venue also shut around 1:10 AM despite being told it would remain open until at least 1:30 AM. Overall, terrible customer service, false commitments, poor management, and a complete waste of a Saturday night. There are far better places in Bandra to spend your money. Game Palacio should be your last choice.
